Brass identification plates

Built around quote-ready production details.

Custom Brass Name Plates should be specified around actual use: artwork, size, material, finish, attachment, quantity, packing and whether each piece uses different text or serial data. Clear details reduce quoting time and help the first sample match the bulk order.

BadgeCraft Metalworks supports OEM production for North America, Canada and Europe orders. The usual starting MOQ is 100 pieces per design, sample time is about 7 days after artwork approval, and bulk production is about 15 days after sample confirmation.

  • Common materials: brass or brass-plated zinc alloy depending on budget and detail.
  • Surface options: brushed brass, polished brass, antique brass, engraved black fill or printed logo.
  • Attachment or mounting: screw holes, adhesive backing, pins, magnets or custom mounting.
  • Typical starting MOQ: 100 pieces per design, adjusted by process.
  • Sample lead time: about 7 days after artwork approval.
  • Bulk production: about 15 days after sample approval.
  • Accepted artwork files: PSD, PDF and editable vector files when available.

FAQ

Custom Brass Name Plates questions.

Can brass name plates be engraved with black fill?

Yes. Engraved recessed text can be filled for stronger contrast on polished or brushed brass.

Can brass plates include screw holes?

Yes. Hole diameter, spacing and corner radius should be provided before sampling.

Are brass name plates suitable for equipment?

Yes for many indoor equipment and branding uses. For harsher environments, stainless steel or aluminum may be recommended.
